name: ASWAGANDHA GUMMIES
description:
Ashwagandha gummies are dietary supplements that contain ashwagandha extract in a gummy form. Ashwagandha, also known as Withania somnifera, is an adaptogenic herb used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine for its potential health benefits, including stress reduction, improved mood, enhanced cognitive function, and better sleep quality.

Potential Benefits:
Stress Reduction: Ashwagandha may help lower cortisol levels, the hormone associated with stress.
Improved Mood: It can have a positive effect on mood and may help with symptoms of anxiety and depression.
Enhanced Cognitive Function: Some studies suggest that ashwagandha can improve memory and cognitive abilities.
Better Sleep Quality: Ashwagandha is often used to promote relaxation and better sleep.

name: Fadogia Agrestis Capsules
description:
Fadogia Agrestis is a lesser-known herbal supplement derived from a shrub native to parts of Africa, particularly found in regions like Nigeria. It has gained popularity in recent years, particularly in the fitness and testosterone-boosting communities, due to claims that it may help increase testosterone levels, improve libido, and enhance athletic performance.
While research on Fadogia Agrestis is still limited, it is often marketed as a natural supplement for improving sexual health, muscle mass, and overall physical vitality. Below is an overview of what is known about Fadogia Agrestis and its potential benefits, risks, and usage.

Key Benefits of Fadogia Agrestis:
Boosts Testosterone Levels:
Fadogia Agrestis is most commonly used for its potential to boost testosterone levels. Some animal studies have suggested that the plant may increase the production of testosterone in the body, leading to improved energy, libido, and muscle growth.
While there is limited human research, animal studies have shown that Fadogia Agrestis can stimulate the production of luteinizing hormone (LH), which signals the testes to produce more testosterone.
